About Loan Against Mutual Funds Customer question Simple answer What is a Loan Against Mutual Funds? It is a loan given against eligible mutual fund units. Your selected units are pledged as security for the loan. Do I need to sell my mutual funds to take this loan? No. You do not need to sell the eligible units. The selected units are pledged as security. Will the mutual funds remain in my name? Yes. The mutual fund units remain in your name, but a lien is placed on the pledged units until it is removed. Can the value of my mutual funds change after pledging? Yes. Mutual fund values can go up or down with the market. The value is not guaranteed. Can I continue to receive gains or dividends on pledged units? Yes. Since your units stay invested, you can still get dividends or growth, depending on what that particular mutual fund scheme offers. What is a lien? A lien is a hold placed on the selected mutual fund units because they are being used as security for the loan. What is MF Central? MF Central is an official online portal (used by mutual fund companies in India) where you complete the pledge — the process of marking your units as loan security. Is this an unsecured loan? No. It is a secured loan because eligible mutual fund units are pledged as security. What can I use the loan amount for? You can use the amount for your permitted personal or business needs, as per the loan terms. Please do not use it for any purpose that is not allowed under the agreement. 2. Eligibility and Loan Amount Customer question Simple answer Who can apply for this loan? You can apply if you hold eligible mutual fund units that qualify for this loan (minimum holding typically Rs. 22,000 for equity or Rs. 16,000 for debt funds, depending on fund type), and you meet our standard borrower checks, such as KYC verification. Are all mutual funds eligible? No. Only the mutual funds and units that meet the lender’s rules will be shown as eligible. Why are some of my mutual funds not eligible? Some schemes may be locked, restricted or not supported for this loan.

the mutual funds and units that meet the lender’s rules will be shown as eligible. Why are some of my mutual funds not eligible? Some schemes may be locked, restricted or not supported for this loan. Only eligible schemes will be considered. How is my eligible loan amount calculated? We check the current value of your eligible mutual fund units and apply a fixed percentage based on the fund type. That percentage becomes your loan amount. Will I get a loan equal to the full value of my mutual funds? No. Only a part of the eligible mutual fund value can be offered as a loan. Can I choose a smaller loan amount? Yes. When applying, you can choose to borrow less than the maximum amount you're eligible for. Can I increase the loan amount later? No. Once your loan is approved and disbursed, the loan amount cannot be increased. Why did my eligible amount change? The amount can change if the mutual fund value, eligible units or selected units change. Does seeing an offer mean my loan is approved? No. You must complete all required steps and final checks before the loan facility is approved. What is LTV? LTV means Loan-to-Value ratio. It is the percentage of your eligible mutual fund value

It is the percentage of your eligible mutual fund value that can be offered as a loan. The LTV may vary based on the type of mutual fund. Please check the eligible loan amount shown in your journey. Why is my loan amount lower than the value of my mutual funds? The full value of your mutual funds cannot be offered as a loan. The eligible amount is calculated after applying the applicable LTV to your eligible mutual fund units. Can the LTV change? Yes. The applicable LTV may change based on the type of mutual fund and the lending rules. Please check the latest eligible amount shown in your journey. 3. Interest, Charges and Repayment Customer question Simple answer Do I pay interest on the full sanctioned amount? No. You only pay interest on the amount you actually withdraw, not your full approved limit. The exact rate is in your Key Fact Statement (KFS) and loan agreement. Where can I see my interest rate? No. Once your loan has been disbursed, the interest rate will not change for the duration of your loan. What charges will I have to pay? The applicable charges will be shown in your KFS and loan agreement. Please read them before accepting the loan. Are there charges for pledging and removing the lien? There may be lien marking and lien removal charges. Please check the exact amount in your KFS or agreement. How will I repay the loan? You'll repay as per the schedule in your loan documents. You pay monthly interest only during the loan tenure. The principal is repaid at the end of the tenure (balloon repayment). What is balloon repayment? You pay interest only each month during the loan period. The full principal is due at the end of the agreed tenure. Can I repay the loan early? Yes. Early repayment or foreclosure is allowed as per your loan terms. Shriram Credit LAMF does not charge any foreclosure or pre-closure fees. Please check your loan agreement for the repayment process. Late or missed payments may lead to charges and other action as per the loan agreement. Please pay on time and contact the approved support channel if needed. 4. Pledge, Documents and Security Customer question Simple answer Why do I need to pledge my mutual funds? The pledge gives security for the loan. The loan facility cannot be completed without pledging the required eligible units. Will the pledged units be sold immediately? No. The units are not sold during the normal loan process. Action may be taken only as per the loan agreement if required. Can I redeem pledged mutual funds? Normally, pledged units cannot be freely redeemed until the lien is removed or changed through the approved process. Can I change the pledged mutual funds or add an additional pledge later? KYC is required to verify your identity, address, declarations and bank details before the loan can be completed. Why do I need to sign the loan agreement? The agreement contains the terms of your loan. Please read it carefully before signing. What is the KFS? KFS means Key Fact Statement. It shows important details such as interest rate, APR, charges and repayment terms. Why do I need an e-Mandate? An e-Mandate is a one-time digital authorisation that lets us auto-debit your monthly interest payments from your bank account on the due date, so you don't have to pay manually each time. Should I share my OTP, PIN or password with the caller? No. Never share your OTP, PIN, password or CVV. Enter them only on the official page. 5. Withdrawal and Disbursal Customer question Simple answer What is the sanctioned amount? It is the maximum loan facility approved for you, subject to the loan terms and current account conditions. What is the available withdrawal balance? It is the amount currently available for you to withdraw. Do I have to withdraw the full sanctioned amount? No. Borrow only the amount you need. Can I withdraw only part of the available amount? Yes, if the amount is within the limits shown in the official journey. Can I withdraw again later? Yes, if your facility allows it and an available withdrawal balance is shown. Where will the money be credited? The amount will be credited to the verified bank account registered in your loan journey, after successful processing. Will the full requested amount be credited? The final credited amount may be lower if applicable charges are deducted.

The final credited amount may be lower if applicable charges are deducted. Please check your documents and transaction details. How long will disbursal take? Eligible and approved loan requests submitted on a working day before 5:30 PM will be processed for disbursal on the same day. Requests submitted after 5:30 PM or on a non-working day will be processed on the next working day, subject to successful completion of all required processes. How do I know if the withdrawal is complete? Check the status in Transaction Details and the updated balance on your dashboard. What if the withdrawal is already processing? Please do not submit another request. Wait for the status to update. Can I cancel a withdrawal after submitting it? It depends on the current status. Cancellation may not be possible once processing has started. What if I do not need more money? We recommend using the remaining loan amount whenever you need it. However, if you let us know that you do not require any further withdrawals, we will record your response and stop contacting you about it.

Account, Support and Privacy Customer question Simple answer Where can I see my loan details? Open the Loan Details section to see the interest rate, sanction date, tenure, repayment type and other account information. Where can I see my withdrawals and repayments? Check Transaction Details, Statements and Repayment Schedule in your account. What should I do if the amount or status looks wrong? Do not continue if the information looks incorrect. Note the issue and use the approved support channel. Can the caller complete the journey for me? No. You must personally complete every step yourself – OTP verification, giving consent, eSigning, setting up the e-Mandate and withdrawal funds. No one can do these for you. Can the caller send me the journey link? No. The official journey link is sent separately by the Marketing team. A resend request can be recorded if needed. How do I know the call is genuine? Your data will be used only as described in the official privacy notice and the consent given during the journey. Can I ask for the calls to stop? Yes. Your request for help can be recorded for review. 7. Questions About Other Loan Products Customer question Simple answer Do you provide Loan Against Shares? We do not provide Loan Against Shares at the moment. This journey is only for Loan Against Mutual Funds. Can I take a loan against stocks or equity shares?
